For the supplied CCX middle network, let a,b,t be bits and write XOR as bit parity. The network restores all bits and accumulates T-exponent Q=-(t XOR b)+(t XOR b XOR a)-(t XOR a)+b+t+a-(a XOR b). Expanding x XOR y=x+y-2xy gives Q=4abt. Thus its full phase-aware middle action is -1 only for 111, namely CCZ; conjugation by H on the target yields CCX. With the X and CX gate cases and chronological composition, list induction gives D(compile p)=P(E(p)). This is a mathematical reconstruction using the supplied macro semantics, not a proof-body audit.

Each H stores pi/2, each T stores pi/8 and each Tdagger stores -pi/8. A CCX has two H, four T and three Tdagger, so its exact stored angle is 2(pi/2)+(4-3)(pi/8)=9pi/8. The concrete program contains five CCX; its remaining X and CX gates have stored angle zero. Its total is exactly 45pi/8, with no automatic reduction modulo 2pi.

The complete-program theorem gives C=exp(-i45pi/8)P(E)=exp(i3pi/8)P(E). Because 0<3pi/8<pi, this scalar has positive imaginary part and is neither 0 nor 1. Each nonzero bare matrix entry equals this scalar, so the historical exact bare C=P(E), and indeed any exact 0/1 permutation-matrix claim, is false for this concrete source compiler. Full D is still the exact basis permutation.
